title: Wood2 Solo #47 (목재 솔로 · lacewood · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Middle Eastern · 메이크업 클래식 레드립 강함 · 배경 대리석 홀 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long wavy honey blonde hair — full body silvery-gold lacewood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING silvery-gold lacewood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID copper flecks running between the carved sections, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots carved from the same lacewood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same lacewood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque matte classic red lips with a precise edge, a sharp black winged liner, defined lashes, a clean complexion.

Background: a bright grand hall with a pale marble floor, tall columns, standard-height arched doors and soft golden daylight through high windows, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
